answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 38202 Country: India Title: My question is 30 people recite 30 juz to complete a Quran for a deceased person, as isal-e-sawab Question: My question is 30 people recite 30 juz to complete a Quran for a deceased person, as isal-e-sawab. Whether reciting the holy Quran like this is permissible or one person should complete reciting the full Quran? Answer ID: 38202 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 735/735/M=1433) Whatever part of the holy Quran one wants to recite, he may recite and can do isal-e-sawab. If a person does isal-e-sawab by reciting the whole Quran then it is too lawful rather it is better. The more one recites the more reward he shall gain. But the ongoing method of Quran khawani is makrooh in which people get together in a fixed date and recite the holy Quran. One should avoid it. One should recite and do isal-e-sawab individually without the specification of date and time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
